definition: Collector's project-specific sample name, which must be unique for each sample within the dataset that you are submitting.
User-defined identifier that indicates what methods are relevant to the entire row of data (i.e., sample).
User-defined identifier that indicates a flag for the entire row of data.
User-defined identifier that indicates what treatment was used for manipulation experiments, if applicable.
User-defined identifier that indicates what methods were used for the individual measurement in the corresponding measurement_column_name.
User-defined identifier that indicates a flag for the individual measurement in the corresponding measurement_column_name.
Cumulative time elapsed, to known specificity, between the first measurement and the current measurement, on a single sample.
Date and time of measurement, to known specificity.
Free text notes field.
Attribute identifier associated with either a method ID, flag, or treatment ID.
Attribute identifier type
Description of the attribute identifier provided within the attr_id field. The description should hold enough detail to pass peer review in a journal article methods section.
Detection limit associated with the analysis (i.e., the lowest / smallest quantity that can be measured), in the units of the reported measurement
Precision associated with the analysis (i.e., how close repeated measures are to each other), in the units of the reported measurement
Precision of the instrument/sensor (i.e., the smallest difference between measurements that the instrument can resolve), in the units of the reported measurement
Lower bound of expected data values, in the units of the reported measurement
Upper bound of expected data values, in the units of the reported measurement
Instrument specifications (e.g., type; model; manufacturer; manufacturing location)
Citation or link to published method description
Hold time for the method, including the units
Temperature at which method was carried out
Light conditions for the method
Atmosphere for the method
Moisture conditions of sample exposed to method
Medium used for the method (e.g. extractions; dilutions; nutrient media for incubations).
Time span for method (e.g. incubation time; storage time; extraction time)
Contact details for the laboratory where the method was performed.
Name of the instrument operator
